title: Foam Roll and Breathe
description: Players use a foam roller or their own body weight to release tight muscles while focusing on slow, controlled breathing to finish practice.

content.objective: Release muscle tightness from practice while training slow, controlled breathing as part of recovery.
content.setup: Each player finds a personal space on the floor with a foam roller if available.
instructions: Roll the calves slowly for 30 seconds each side, breathing deeply throughout.
Roll the quads slowly for 30 seconds each side.
Roll the upper back slowly for 30 seconds.
Finish lying still for 30 seconds focusing only on slow breathing.
coachingPoints: Move slowly — rushing the roll reduces its benefit.
Breathe out slowly through any uncomfortable spot rather than holding tension.
Keep the room calm and quiet during the final breathing portion.
commonMistakes: Rolling too quickly to finish faster.
Holding the breath instead of breathing through tight spots.
Skipping the breathing and stretching once the group gets talkative.
content.safety: Avoid rolling directly over any joint; stop immediately if there is sharp pain.
